review_description: My approach was to compare the hardware, performance, price and warranty to work out the best system for us; i.e. (truely) the highest quality we could get.Apart from the published data, many of the tables and comparisons on your site helped me with that.One of several SolarWide offers was a close 2nd.
All the solar companies you recommended were professional and competitive.The panels will be installed next week which is only a few weeks after signing up.
